summary: Good starts with a flat hand at the chin and lands palm-up on the other palm. It's the base of good morning, good night, and good job.
movement: Dominant hand moves from the chin down to land on the non-dominant palm
steps: Touch the fingertips of your flat dominant hand to your chin, palm facing you.
Bring the hand down and forward to land palm-up on your flat non-dominant palm.
Nod slightly. For casual 'good,' many signers skip the second hand and just move from the chin outward.
note: GOOD and THANK-YOU begin identically. GOOD lands on your other hand; THANK-YOU goes out toward the person. BAD starts the same way and flips over.
mistakes: Starting at the lips. The hand starts at the chin.
Confusing it with THANK-YOU. Remember: GOOD lands, THANK-YOU goes out.
